nodes.label: Local Runtime (separate process :8100)

nodes.norm_label: route aliases & fallback before first token
nodes.rationale: Routes fast/smart/local/code/autocomplete/vision/reason/image/embed-default with priority/round_robin; fallback only on retryable errors (timeout, 429, 5xx, model_busy, device_oom) and only before first chunk.

nodes.label: Device/VRAM Manager (budget, pin, LRU eviction, queue)
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.norm_label: device/vram manager (budget, pin, lru eviction, queue)
nodes.rationale: GPU and NPU are only 8 GB each; 7-8B models cannot co-reside, so pinned + swap slot + LRU eviction with min residency 60s prevents OOM and thrashing.

nodes.label: MVC layering (routes -> controllers -> services -> models)
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.rationale: Routes must not access DB directly; services must not return FastAPI Response objects. Runtime reuses same layering.

nodes.label: No CPU inference policy (ALLOW_CPU_FALLBACK)
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.rationale: All local models must run on GPU/NPU; n_gpu_layers=-1, explicit OpenVINO device never AUTO/CPU; runtime refuses to start without accelerators unless dev flag set.

nodes.label: NPU static shapes & compile cache (OV_CACHE_DIR)
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.rationale: NPU requires static shapes (SD 512x512, embedding seq 512); compilation is slow so persistent cache is mandatory.

nodes.label: API key auth (lgw_ prefix, HMAC-SHA256 with pepper, scopes)

nodes.norm_label: api key auth (lgw_ prefix, hmac-sha256 with pepper, scopes)

nodes.label: Deployment modes (without/with Traefik)
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.rationale: Traefik only routes to gateway, never to runtime; writeTimeout 0s so long streams and model swaps do not drop connections.

nodes.label: Rate limit (in-memory RPM/TPM) & quotas
nodes.author: Fahrul
nodes.rationale: No Redis in portable no-admin environment; in-memory rate limit + PostgreSQL counters, requiring APP_WORKERS=1.
